findings.title: Final holds lack retained reason/scope and analysis rejection detail
findings.trigger: Classify the final sixteen holds after private cleanup
findings.observed: Final report retains code counts only. ANALYSIS_INCOMPLETE count1 is one diagnostic, not proof that only one mapping was rejected.
findings.impact: Cannot decide whether a hold is missing business evidence, invalid mapping, duplicated confirmed fact or another unresolved cause.
findings.minimumAction: Reuse existing createFindingSummary and retain sanitized reason/category/scope/requiredEvidence/affectsApply/digest plus analysis rejection count/reason enums during the next authorized run; no restoration of deleted originals.

findings.title: Original final report omitted exact test selection
findings.observed: Reconstructed the recorded 33 Node files, critical-flow pattern, 24 Python module selection and additional diagnostics command from the execution history and preserved Git source; no test rerun.
findings.remainingLimit: Original per-test logs, case names and historical Node version remain unavailable; this is a retrospective manifest, not original execution output.

findings.title: Saved response reuse requires a currently authorized retained fixture
findings.observed: The six responses were reused before cleanup and were then deleted as requested. Future replay must not assume those files still exist.
findings.minimumAction: Preserve the historical replay result and condition future replay on an available authorized fixture.

findings.title: Agent projection/assembly implementation is outside the UI generator fingerprint
findings.trigger: Deploy only Agent projection/assembly changes between analysis and generation
findings.impact: The same checkpoint may produce different final model instructions despite unchanged UI generator hash. No current source tampering or deployed mismatch was observed.
findings.minimumAction: At the next Agent projection change, add and verify a scoped adapter revision or explicitly migrate/review affected checkpoints; do not expand this into an immediate architecture rewrite.
